channel.title: Sri Prasanna MG: writing
channel.description: Product and technology leader in industrial automation. From machine commissioning to platform strategy, now focused on agentic and physical AI the factory floor can trust.

item.title: The model is the smallest part
item.description: Industrial AI is mostly identity, authority, reliability and audit. The intelligence is the easy share, and it is becoming a commodity.

item.title: Simulation has to write rules
item.description: A digital twin is worth its cost when its answers become limits the real machine respects.

item.title: Code owns the verdict
item.description: If a decision matters, it does not belong in a prompt.

item.title: Never worse than today
item.description: The design rule that makes AI acceptable in production: when the intelligence is unsure or unavailable, the machine behaves exactly as it does now.

item.title: Agents will need badges
item.description: Before agents work alongside operators and technicians, identity, traceability, and accountability must become first-class.

item.title: Scaling intelligence down
item.description: World models could change which machines can afford to be intelligent.

item.title: Industrial software has memory
item.description: Long lifecycles are not merely legacy. They are accumulated decisions.

item.title: Platforms are trust systems
item.description: Self-service is not a portal feature. It is a promise that the platform will behave.

item.title: Workflow-shaped intelligence
item.description: The useful industrial agent will understand the work around the model, not only the prompt.

item.title: GitOps is a promise
item.description: The YAML matters less than whether reality can be rebuilt from intent.

item.title: Agents need engineering discipline
item.description: An agent is not magic labor. It is an unreliable engineering participant with tools.

item.title: Permissions are product decisions
item.description: Agent autonomy is defined less by prompts than by what tools are allowed to do.

item.title: Commissioning is the real test
item.description: Architecture becomes honest when it meets a machine, a deadline, and incomplete information.

item.title: Cloud-decorated industrial software
item.description: Containers and YAML can change the costume without changing how software behaves.

item.title: Platforms need product thinking
item.description: Internal does not mean the users have no choice.
